test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter and symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) Z # U * Y $ K W P Q @ G & A % J B L % & H D # V (Right)

Which of the following is the twelfth letter/symbol to the left of the eighteenth letter/symbol from the left end of the given series?
solution:
Given terms: (Left) Z # U * Y $ K W P Q @ G & A % J B L % & H D # V (Right)

Here,

Eighteenth letter/symbol from the left end: **L **(Z # U * Y $ K W P Q @ G & A % J B __**L**__ % & H D # V)

And, twelfth letter/symbol to the left of **L** is: **$ **(Z # U * Y __**$**__ K W P Q @ G & A % J B __L__ % & H D # V)

So, the twelfth letter/symbol to the left of the eighteenth letter/symbol from the left end of the given series are: '**$**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
